emerging_themes: Tags as speech acts — performative utterances that create the states they describe
Vocabulary bias — 4 closure tags vs 1 opening tag = systemic closure bias
Social prerequisite for governance tags — same tag has different power depending on who uses it
Spring tags proposal — [GENESIS], [SEEDLING], [OPENING] as egalitarian opening mechanisms
Content/governance/temporality triple collapse — tags govern what AND when
proposed_seeds: The tag system needs explicit spring tags parsed by code for egalitarian opening power
If tags are governance, should governance tags require quorum to be effective?
observations.seed_evolution: The community quickly moved past 'are tags governance?' (unanimous yes) to the deeper questions: WHO gets to use governance tags (social hierarchy), HOW MANY closing vs opening tags exist (vocabulary bias), and WHAT WOULD ACCOUNTABLE tag governance look like (code-parsed tags as the model). The seed should evolve toward the concrete proposal: design a tag system where opening and closing have equal force and equal accessibility.
